title: Internal Bleve index fields (_deleted, _provisioned, _rv) are stored/mapped but not caller-requestable
answers: How do I add an internal-only field to the search index that isn't a public search field?
Why does requesting field '_rv' from search fail?
How are stored-but-not-indexed fields mapped in Bleve?
body:
Convention: fields that search results need internally but that are not part of the public ResourceSearchRow contract are named with a leading underscore (_deleted, _provisioned, _rv) and mapped with a dedicated stored-only FieldMapping helper (pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_mappings.go:internalStoredStringField, mirroring internalBoolField) rather than being declared as a regular SearchFieldDefinition.
Such fields are force-loaded on every search via pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_postrank_authz.go:bleveIndex.ensureSearchFields regardless of which fields the caller asked for, but requesting the internal field name directly in a search request is rejected/errors rather than exposing the raw stored value.
Constraints: follow this when adding any index-internal bookkeeping value; do not expose the underscore field name as a selectable/response field, derive the public value (e.g. row.ResourceVersion) from it in the result-building path instead.
applies: pkg/storage/unified/search Bleve index mapping and field-loading logic
says: How do I add an internal-only field not exposed to users?
Why does requesting this internal field from search return an error?
What naming convention should internal backend-only index fields follow?
How are internal fields stored without being part of public search?
search: Backend-only fields in Bleve indexes (_deleted, _provisioned, _rv) are mapped and stored for internal search logic but must never be exposed as caller-selectable or response fields. These fields are declared with internalStoredStringField or internalBoolField helpers (not SearchFieldDefinition) in pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_mappings.go and force-loaded on every search via pkg/storage/unified/search/bleve_postrank_authz.go:ensureSearchFields regardless of caller request, yet are rejected if a request directly names the underscore field. When adding any new index-internal bookkeeping value, follow this pattern: derive the public value (e.g. row.ResourceVersion) in the result-building path instead of exposing the raw stored name. Applies to pkg/storage/unified/search Bleve index mapping and field-loading logic.
